notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress. The verified Windows audio implementation includes Rust audio contracts and bounded queues, device catalog/reselection, bounded stream recovery, IAudioClient3 shared-mode period planning, SharedCapturePlan cadence, event-driven WASAPI IAudioCaptureClient capture, native sample decoding, packet reframing and AudioFrame assembly, a bounded event-driven CapturePump, structured recoverable WASAPI lifecycle failures, CaptureRuntime with externally scheduled bounded reopen recovery and sequence continuity, IMMNotificationClient registration on a dedicated Windows MTA thread with bounded non-blocking notification delivery, and owner-thread capture-route notification filtering/deduplication. The bounded user-mode virtual-microphone staging/output boundary is verified: VirtualMicStagingBuffer enforces a fixed format, drops the oldest frame on overflow to bound latency, emits fresh silence on underrun rather than replaying stale speech, and exposes accepted/drop/underrun counters; VirtualMicOutputBridge sends both successfully processed AudioPipeline frames and original safe-bypass frames through the same staging path. A versioned Rust driver-facing protocol contract is verified, and native/windows-virtual-mic now provides its MSVC x64 C++ ABI mirror. ProtocolHeader and CursorSnapshot are each locked to 40 bytes with 8-byte alignment and exact field offsets; the C++ validation and cyclic-ring/session/cursor behavior match the Rust contract. Implementation head 93c166709e3fad6aecd924a0378316761a9e318f passed Ubuntu repository-integrity run 34528681411 and Windows Audio Validation run 34528681382, where the C++ ABI executable compiled under /W4 /WX and ran successfully. This is native ABI evidence, not evidence of an OS-visible virtual microphone or real kernel/user shared transport. Physical unplug/replug or communications-default change recovery on controlled hardware, hardware CPU/latency/jitter/deadline evidence, the WDK WaveRT endpoint, shared-memory synchronization/memory ordering, IOCTL/device-interface/security ACL/section mapping and actual kernel transport mechanics, processed/bypass audio reaching approved calling applications, and driver signing/install/update/uninstall/rollback remain pending. README and docs/architecture/WINDOWS-AUDIO-IMPLEMENTATION.md are reconciled to this boundary. WU-002 and MOD-002 are not complete until required routing, compatibility and performance evidence exists. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and production deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates.
